**Finding submitted: compliant** (no redline).

The rule is satisfied at the **preferred** position — the Agreement contains no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding Clear Capital. The task-by-task SOW structure affirmatively preserves our freedom to source elsewhere, and there is no minimum-volume or shortfall-fee mechanic that would create de facto exclusivity. The "exclusive" language present in the document either benefits us (non-exclusive perpetual license) or is unrelated boilerplate.
